Complete the application form with academic history and choose the programme plus specialisation.
Upload scanned documents — marksheets, photo ID, passport photograph and signature.
Pay the application fee where applicable and submit the form.
Wait for the eligibility check by the admission cell; queries are raised on email or phone.
Pay the first instalment or semester fee to confirm the seat once the offer is issued.
Receive the enrolment number and LMS credentials, then begin the induction module.
